env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOOS=linux
env GOARCH=amd64
env GOAMD64=v1
env GOARM64=v8.0
env CGO_ENABLED=0

cd features
logos build -tags=keep --emit-go=out
exists out/baseline.go
exists out/high.go
exists out/cross.go
exists out/armlevel.go
cd out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -tags=keep ./...
env GOAMD64=v3
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -tags=keep ./...
env GOARCH=arm64
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -tags=keep ./...
env GOARM64=v9.1
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -tags=keep ./...
cd ../..

# No real target can imply v3 while omitting v2. Eject must reject
# this constraint instead of inventing a user tag and compiling v1.
env GOARCH=amd64
env GOAMD64=v1
cd impossible
! logos eject -o out
stderr 'no build context selects inactive file .*impossible.lgo'

-- features/go.mod --
module example.com/features

go 1.27

-- features/main.lgo --
package features

func Value() int { return 42 }

-- features/baseline.lgo --
//go:build amd64 && !amd64.v2 && keep

package features

func Baseline() int { return 1 }

-- features/high.lgo --
//go:build amd64 && amd64.v3 && !amd64.v4 && keep

package features

func High() int { return 3 }

-- features/cross.lgo --
//go:build arm64 && !amd64.v1 && keep

package features

func Cross() int { return 64 }

-- features/armlevel.lgo --
//go:build arm64 && arm64.v9.1 && arm64.v8.6 && keep

package features

func ArmLevel() int { return 91 }

-- impossible/go.mod --
module example.com/impossible

go 1.27

-- impossible/main.lgo --
package impossible

func Value() int { return 1 }

-- impossible/impossible.lgo --
//go:build amd64 && amd64.v3 && !amd64.v2

package impossible

func CannotExist() int { return 3 }
